system.description:
Deal [(SR)D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target. You may make the target make a [Safe Move (forced)] of 1 Sq.

A special skill that allows a throwing weapon imbued with fighting spirit to freely fly through the air like a bird of prey on a falconry. Its blow, which resembles the appearance of a shining bird, drives its prey in all directions, toying with it.
